description: 13-week cash-flow forecast. Returns current bank balance, projected weekly inflows/outflows/running balance for the next 13 weeks, projected low point, recurring patterns detected from history, outstanding invoices expected to clear, recurring invoice projections, and tax deadlines that could draw cash. Also returns tax_set_aside: the tax to keep aside (sales tax owed, the running company tax balance on this year's profit less tax already paid, the recommended set-aside rate and amount when one is saved, and for a company with tax instalments the next instalment, the schedule paid so far against due so far, the balance-due date and the basis). Use when the user asks about cashflow, runway, "can I afford X", "when will I run out", how much to set aside for tax, or their next tax instalment, or wants to plan ahead. Quote the figures it returns; never work out an instalment yourself.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.
